title: DC Voltage Controller
text: 带前馈零点对消和积分抗饱和的离散时间 DC 电压 PI 控制，输入 3 路、输出 1 路；{Proportional gain} 指定比例增益，K p、{Integral gain} 指定积分增益 K i、{Anti-windup gain} 指定抗饱和增益 K aw、{Control action upper limit} 控制信号的上限，control max、{Control action lower limit} 控制信号的下限，control min、{Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间、{Discretization sample time} 指定离散化采样时间、{Time constant voltage filter} 指定 DC 电压滤波器时间常数，τ、{Enable zero cancellation} 指定前馈零消去、{Filter DC voltage} 指定直流电压滤波器，按实例取值。

ports.name: vRef
ports.summary: 参考 DC 电压 scalar

ports.name: v
ports.summary: 测量 DC 电压 scalar

params.name: Proportional gain
params.values: 比例增益，K p 0.1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Integral gain
params.values: 积分增益 K i 50 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Anti-windup gain
params.values: 抗饱和增益 K aw 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Control action upper limit
params.values: 控制信号的上限，control max 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Control action lower limit
params.values: 控制信号的下限，control min 0 (default) | non-negative scalar

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Discretization sample time
params.values: 离散化采样时间 0.001 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Time constant voltage filter
params.values: DC 电压滤波器时间常数，τ 0.001 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Filter DC voltage
params.values: 直流电压滤波器选项 on (default) | off
